# Theme builder

<p class="bootcn-lead">Pick a style, a neutral scale, a primary color and a radius. See them on a full page, then copy the CSS.</p>

Every combination keeps text at 4.5:1 and focus rings at 3:1 against their
backgrounds, in light and dark mode. Switch the site theme to see both.

<ThemeBuilder />

## Styles

- **Default**: outlined fields and cards with a hairline border.
- **Soft**: tinted fields instead of outlines, cards on soft shadows and
  larger corners, in the spirit of HeroUI. It is also a registry item:
  `npx bootcn add soft`, then load `soft.css` after the component styles.
